data.synopsis:
Sakurai Taichi, facing a financial crunch, lands a job as an assistant on a film shoot where he reunites with his schoolmate and the most beautiful girl in school, Himawari Kanan. To his surprise, the shoot turns out to be for an adult video, which initially shocks Taichi, who tries to decline the offer. However, Kanan accepts the role, claiming it will be an educational experience. Despite feeling uncomfortable with Kanan's bold actions, Taichi finds enjoyment in working alongside her. During the shoot, the lead actor has an accident, and Taichi steps in to replace him, which leads Kanan to also participate in the video.

(Source: TMDB)

data.title: Wonderful Precure! Movie: Dokidoki Game no Sekai de Daibouken!
data.title_japanese: わんだふるぷりきゅあ！ざ・むーびー！ドキドキ♡ゲームの世界で大冒険！
data.synopsis:
Komugi, Iroha, Yuki, Mayu, Daifuku, and Satoru have gathered to play the super popular game "Doki Doki♡TanuKingdom"! Everyone starts the game happily! Or so they thought...but it seems they've been sucked into a world of the game with a suspicious tanuki...and now they're in even more trouble! Komugi has been separated from Iroha and the others...!?

"I want to be by Iroha's side forever and ever!" To meet her beloved Iroha, Komugi decides to challenge herself to various game battles!

How on earth did this happen...? What is the secret hidden in the world of the game...? The clue is in the hands of Natsuki, the young girl who created the game.

"Hirogaru Sky! Pretty Cure" and "Mahou Tsukai Pretty Cure!" have also gathered together! When everyone's feelings come together, will a wonderful miracle unfold?!

(Source: Pretty Cure Wiki)

data.title: Jian Lai
data.title_japanese: 剑来
data.synopsis:
The world is vast and full of wonders. In the mystical realm of Lizhu Cave, a destitute youth destined for greatness finds his fate upended when his life-bound porcelain shatters. Though fortune beckons, it remains tantalizingly out of reach. As a result, powerful figures begin weaving intricate schemes around him, turning the boy into the linchpin of their designs. While those around him reap extraordinary opportunities, the youth himself is left standing alone at the eye of the storm...

(Source: WeTV)

titles.title: Mirai no Kuromaku-kei Akuyaku Reijou Moriarty no Isekai Kanzen Hanzai Hakusho
未来の黒幕系悪役令嬢モリアーティーの異世界完全犯罪白書

data.title: Mirai no Kuromaku-kei Akuyaku Reijou Moriarty no Isekai Kanzen Hanzai Hakusho
data.title_japanese: 未来の黒幕系悪役令嬢モリアーティーの異世界完全犯罪白書
data.synopsis:
After suffering a crushing defeat against a legendary detective, James Moriarty is reincarnated as a ghost in another world. He wakes up in the body of Sherry Moriarty—a severely bullied student from the elitist All Blue Academy—and manages to save the young woman, who was attempting to take her own life.

Although James has forgotten his name and past, he has retained his criminal expertise and is determined to help Sherry get revenge against Porgrette Whey Cochon and the other noblewomen who have made Sherry's existence miserable. The bullies of All Blue Academy will learn the hard way that when two Moriartys unite to commit the perfect crime, no one can stand in their way.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]
